response.rationale: The item is footwear (not electronics), not final sale, delivered 10 days ago (within the 30-day standard window). RET-007 applies (days_since_delivery <= 30 and final_sale == False), making it eligible. Higher-priority rules do not apply: item is not final sale (RET-012), not defective (RET-020), no fraud hold (RET-051), and no goodwill grant (RET-050).
